create_SSLCertRefresher: create an SSLCertRefresher instance with an SSLContext, key path, cert path, and optional CA path to enable hot-reloading
build_SSLCertRefresher_init: build an SSLCertRefresher by passing an ssl.SSLContext, key_path, cert_path, and optional ca_path to start background watchers
test_watch_cert_key: test the _watch_cert_key method to verify it detects cert and key file changes and reloads the SSL context
test_watch_ca: test the _watch_ca method to verify it detects CA file changes and reloads verification locations
run_SSLCertRefresher_stop: run the stop method on SSLCertRefresher to cancel all background watching tasks
